verdict.rationale: Postman documents a gateway (Fabric Gateway) where MCP servers can be registered and made available to a team, which implies first-party proxying of MCP traffic. Nothing in the evidence shows LLM traffic governance such as token limits, prompt guards, or provider routing. The spec-level API governance checks are a different capability and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: LLM traffic proxying, token/rate limits, prompt guards, provider routing, enforced governance policies on gateway traffic, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can proxy and govern LLM/MCP traffic (token limits, prompt guards, provider routing) through the platform

citations.quote: This guide walks you through registering a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with the gateway and making it available to your team.
